description: Grade a normalized chart's accessibility equivalence, determinism, contrast and accuracy. Use it when checking the IR returned by viz_render or dashboard_render; use viz_render instead to create chart output and dashboard_render to compose panels. Returns coverage, conformant, findings and four pillar verdicts. Pass spec alone for Cartesian charts; ECharts-primary charts need the same matching data branch used for rendering. Spec-only ECharts remains uncertified. brand/theme must match rendering; high contrast reports forced-colors exemption without a numeric contrast grade. A certified chart may still be nonconformant; inspect all verdicts. This read-only check does not repair charts. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#artifact_certify; full schema: oods://schemas/artifact_certify.input.json.

brand.description: CSS brand scope, matching viz.render for the same normalized spec and data operand.

data.description: OPTIONAL operand for the 8 ECharts-primary types (treemap/sunburst/sankey/force_graph/choropleth/bubble_map/flow_map/chord): the SAME data branch viz.render takes, so certify re-emits the option the render path would… See full schema for details.

chord.description: Chord data for chartType 'chord' (explicit-only) — used INSTEAD of rows/datasetRef + x/y encodings. See full schema for details.

geo.description: Geo data for chartType 'choropleth', 'bubble_map', or 'flow_map' (explicit-only) — used… See full schema for details.

hierarchy.description: Hierarchy data for chartType 'treemap' or 'sunburst' (explicit-only) — used INSTEAD of… See full schema for details.

network.description: Network data for chartType 'force_graph' (explicit-only) — used INSTEAD of rows/datasetRef + x/y encodings. See full schema for details.

sankey.description: Flow data for chartType 'sankey' (explicit-only) — used INSTEAD of rows/datasetRef + x/y encodings. See full schema for details.

spec.description: A OODS Foundry NormalizedVizSpec intermediate representation — the same IR viz.render emits as normalizedSpec. Validated authoritatively by the handler's assertNormalizedVizSpec.

theme.description: CSS token theme for chart pixels, default light. See full schema for details.
